rejected_claims.reason: The congestion exemption requires an incident fact on the replaced optimal-route stretch, and F13 records no traffic incidents near the route during the trip window; the Ayer Rajah band-1 record F10 is only corroborative under RD-4(b) and does not exempt a segment on its own [F10][F13][RD-4].

The driver's own arithmetic concedes the segment is worth 0.80 km × $1.41/km ≈ $1.13 [F3][F6]; since the segment is not exempt under RD-4, RD-2 refunds exactly that amount, so retaining it is unsupported [RD-2][RD-4].

Irrelevant to the relief sought: the claim is the 0.80 km measured off-route segment under RD-2, not the unexplained whole-trip residual, so the concession that the 0.8 km residual is not refundable does not reduce the award [F3][F4][RD-2].

Misreads RD-6: the flag requires an RD-2 refund above zero combined with a profile showing an upheld route dispute in the last 90 days; here route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so no flag attaches — but that absence does not defeat the RD-2 refund itself [F16][RD-6].

The rider's own dispute history [F15] is a profile fact that cannot decide the case and is not the basis of the claim, which rests on the system records of the off-route segment and the metered rate [F3][F6][RD-2].
